translations.web: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
translations.bsb: Masters, supply your slaves with what is right and fair, since you know that you also have a Master in heaven.
translations.kjv: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.
translations.asv: Masters, render unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.
